records.source: Urghh... I died again! This game is so hard...$u
records.translation: Argh... Namatay na naman ako! Ang hirap ng larong ito...$u

records.source: %Haley's too involved with her camera to notice you.
records.translation: %Masyadong abala si Haley sa kamera niya para mapansin ka.

records.source: %Harvey looks busy right now.
records.translation: %Mukhang abala si Harvey ngayon.

records.source: Now just hold still... Take a deep breath for me.$u
records.translation: Manatili ka lang diyan... Huminga ka nang malalim para sa akin.$u

records.source: Unghh... Can't talk.$6
records.translation: Unghh... Hindi ako makapagsalita.$6

records.source: %Robin is busy.
records.translation: %Abala si Robin.

records.source: %Demetrius is busy.
records.translation: %Abala si Demetrius.

records.source: We're insulated from the rest of the world here in Stardew Valley. Maybe that's a good thing.
records.translation: Hiwalay tayo sa ibang bahagi ng mundo dito sa Stardew Valley. Siguro mabuti iyon.

records.source: Exercising can be fun!
records.translation: Maaaring maging masaya ang pag-eehersisyo!

records.source: My arms are strong... *pant*... but my legs need work... *gasp*
records.translation: Malakas ang mga braso ko... *hingal*... pero kailangan pang sanayin ang mga binti ko... *habol-hininga*

records.source: Don't look! I'm all red and sweaty.$s
records.translation: Huwag kang tumingin! Pulang-pula ako at pawis na pawis.$s

records.source: %Shane's hard at work. He doesn't seem interested in talking.
records.translation: %Abalang-abala si Shane sa trabaho. Mukhang ayaw niyang makipag-usap.

records.source: %Marnie smiles at you through a mist of sweat.
records.translation: %Nginingitian ka ni Marnie habang tagaktak ang pawis niya.

records.source: Ungh... Breathe in.... Ungh.... Breathe out.$4
records.translation: Ungh... Huminga nang malalim.... Ungh.... Ilabas ang hangin.$4

records.source: Ms. Penny says I have to read this book before I can go play.$s
records.translation: Sabi ni Bb. Penny, kailangan kong basahin ang aklat na ito bago ako makapaglaro.$s

records.source: This town's safe, but I always walk the children home anyway.
records.translation: Ligtas ang bayang ito, pero lagi ko pa ring inihahatid pauwi ang mga bata.

records.source: %Sam is busy practicing the guitar.
records.translation: %Abala si Sam sa pagsasanay sa gitara.

records.source: One sec... I gotta beat this level.$7
records.translation: Sandali... Kailangan kong lampasan ang antas na ito.$7

records.source: %Sam's trying to do a kickflip.
records.translation: %Sinusubukan ni Sam na gumawa ng kickflip.
records.englishResidueReason: Kickflip is the established skateboarding trick name used naturally in Filipino.

records.source: $c .5#Hmm... If I give the cue ball a bit of a top spin, maybe I could...$7#$e#*Sigh*... I'm not very good.$s
records.translation: $c .5#Hmm... Kung paiikutin ko nang kaunti paharap ang puting bola, baka puwede kong...$7#$e#*Buntong-hininga*... Hindi ako gaanong mahusay.$s

records.source: %Sam's on the clock... better not get him in trouble.
records.translation: %Nagtatrabaho si Sam... mabuting huwag siyang mapahamak dahil sa akin.
